job.goal: 30-second promo plus a walkthrough of creating a page

scenes.brief: Show Notion logo and tagline as opening title card.
Dynamic aerial shot of a team collaborating in Notion, with flowing camera movement highlighting pages and databases.
Hero still image of a clean Notion workspace showcasing a project roadmap and wiki.
Step-by-step navigation of creating a new page in Notion, from clicking '+ New Page' to typing a title and adding content.
Closing title card with Notion branding and call-to-action: 'Start creating today'.

voiceover.script: Welcome to Notion, the all-in-one workspace where teams plan, write, and collaborate. See how flexible pages and databases bring ideas to life. Now, watch as we create a new page: click 'New Page', type your title, and add text, tables, or media instantly. With Notion, your workflow stays connected and organized. Start creating today.
